request.instructions: The statement and the source are two sections of the same project's documentation at the same version. Mark the statement contradicted only when the source states an incompatible value, version, limit, name or rule for the same thing in the same scope. If the source is about a different option, hook, function, package or version, the statement is not stated, not contradicted. An example value in a code sample that overrides a default does not contradict the default.
